title: selaginella rupestris var. sartorii
intro: Selaginella rupestris var. sartorii, commonly known as 'Mountain Spikemoss', is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the Selaginellaceae family, characterized by its small, spikemoss-like foliage. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Spikemoss include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions, including skin infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
